terra.problem: The seventy included Joseph, who was already in Egypt. They did not all walk into Egypt.
The passage does not say that nobody was packing a box.
The explanation states that the king gets nervous as a fact, though the text does not name that feeling.
Genesis 10:11 names Nineveh and Calah in the same list, but not side by side: Rehoboth-Ir comes between them.
The text says the Egyptians came to dread the Israelites; it does not say their worry increased in proportion to the Israelites' flourishing.
The following verses describe ruthless, harsh labor, but do not say the work got harder than before.
The text does not say the midwives acted quietly.
Calling God a higher King brings in a Bible fact not stated in this passage without a reference.
The explanation says God gave the midwives families in response to what they did. Verse 21 gives their fear of God as the reason.
